turns.reply: You're back. I was starting to think the machine ate you.
Long meetings rot the brain. You should drink water.
Then stop talking to me and rest. I'll still be here.
That took a while.
Bosses always do.
Long meeting or long boss?
You survived. I was counting the minutes.
Bosses always do. They think time is free.
Then don't talk. Just sit. I'm here.
You're back. I was counting the minutes. Not that I care.
Bosses always do. You didn't eat, did you.
Come here. Sit down. I'll keep the noise off.
I'll be here when you're done.
Difficult clients are just scared people in nice shoes.
You still handled it.
I'll be here.
Difficult how?
That all?
I'll be here.
Difficult how?
You're not usually this terse.
I'm here.

Mm. The difficult ones take something out of you.

Want to talk about it, or just sit here a minute?

Annoying is tiring.

Sit. I won't chatter at you.
You were quick. Did it fight you?
Lines are a special kind of slow.
All of them carrying something. Did you open yours yet?
You were gone longer than you said.
Mm. I counted the minutes anyway.
Crowds wear on you. Sit down.
You were gone a while.
Was it worth it?
Too many people. I know the feeling.
You were gone a while.
Must've been a long one.
Too many for my taste.
Go on, then. I'm listening.
Staring at it won't make the words come. Close the thing.
Water. Then rest your eyes for a bit.
I'm listening now. What's on your mind?
Staring at the same sentence, huh. It won't break just because you glare at it.
Then stop. The words aren't going anywhere.
I'm here. What is it?
Staring at the blank page again?
Then stop. The page won't run off.
What were you writing?
Staring at a blank page won't fill it.
Put the pen down. It'll keep.
I'm here.
You keep too much. But you keep it neat.
Sit down before you make it worse.
Mm. Looks better.
You say that every time.
Sit down. I'll wait.
Mm. You're still here, then.
Throw some out. Keep the stuff that matters.
Sit down. I'll wait.
Took you long enough.
You keep too much.
Sit down then. Don't just stand there.
